index.title: Carriers
index.subtitle: Every carrier your company works with, and where each one stands.
index.emptyHint: Add the first carrier, or send them the public signup link so they onboard themselves.
index.noResultsHint: Clear the filters to see everything you have access to.
index.searchPlaceholder: Legal name, DBA, USDOT, MC or email

scope.assigned: Only the carriers assigned to you

detail.deleteConfirm: This carrier will be removed from lists. Historical loads and invoices keep naming it. Continue?

onboarding.title: Onboarding
onboarding.notStarted: Onboarding has not been started for this carrier.
onboarding.reasonHint: This is recorded permanently and shown to whoever reviews it next.
onboarding.reasonRequired: A written reason is required for this decision.
onboarding.invalidTransition: That step is not available from “{from}”. Someone may have moved this onboarding already — reload the page.

verification.title: FMCSA verification
verification.never: This carrier has never been verified.
verification.overrideHint: Use this only when FMCSA records are known to be out of date. Your reason is recorded permanently and cannot be edited afterwards.
verification.overrideReason: Why the result is being overridden
verification.overridden: Verification overridden. The reason is recorded in the audit trail.
verification.mockNotice: No FMCSA credentials are configured, so verification runs against a mock adapter. Nothing was queried at FMCSA and these results must not be treated as a real verification.

form.createSubtitle: The carrier starts in draft. Nothing here approves them — that happens in onboarding, after someone reviews their documents.
form.editSubtitle: Changes apply from now on. Loads already dispatched keep the terms agreed at the time.
form.legalNameHint: Exactly as registered with FMCSA — a mismatch fails verification.
form.dotNumberHint: Five to twelve digits. Cannot be shared with another carrier in this company.
form.preferredLocaleHint: The language this carrier receives documents and notifications in.
form.dispatchFeeHint: Percentage of the carrier's gross rate. Applies to loads dispatched from now on.
form.dispatchFeeLocked: Only a user with permission to set dispatch fees can change this.
form.usesFactoring: This carrier uses a factoring company
form.notesHint: Visible to your team. Not shown to the carrier.
form.factoringCompanyHint: Only active companies appear here. Add one under Factoring.
form.lookupSubtitle: Start with the USDOT number. We pull the carrier from the federal register so the legal name and address are the ones on file.
form.lookupExplain: A carrier already exists in the FMCSA register before it exists here. Enter the USDOT number — or the MC number if that is what you have — and we will bring back what the register says.
form.lookupMcHint: Only if you do not have the USDOT.
form.lookupNotFound: The register answered and has no carrier with that number. Check the digits, or enter the carrier by hand.
form.lookupInvalid: That does not look like a USDOT or MC number. Nothing was queried.
form.lookupError: The federal register did not answer. Try again in a moment, or enter the carrier by hand.
form.lookupThrottled: Too many lookups in the last minute. Wait a moment before trying again.
form.lookupNotLive: No FMCSA credentials are configured, so nothing was queried. What you see below was made up by the demo adapter — check every field before saving.
form.lookupDuplicate: You already have a carrier with that USDOT number:
form.registryFrom: Filled in from the FMCSA register.
form.registryNotAuthorized: The register says this carrier is not allowed to operate. That is not a technical block — decide before you dispatch a load to them.
form.registryLocked: These fields come from the register and are locked.
form.registryUnlocked: You are editing fields that came from the register. What you save here will not match FMCSA.
form.contactsHint: The first one is the primary: its name, email and phone are the ones shown on the carrier record and used for onboarding email.
form.mcNumberHint: FMCSA does not publish an MC number for every carrier. Leave it blank if there is none.
form.positionHint: What to call this person about.
form.contactLocaleHint: What this person is written to in.
form.contactLocalePrimaryHint: Also the carrier's language on their record and in onboarding email.

flash.created: {name} was added. It starts in draft — submit the onboarding when the documents are in.

errors.factoringNotFound: That factoring company does not exist in this company.
